verdict.rationale: Paxos offers rule-based orchestrations that trigger automatically on events (e.g., bank transfer received triggers mint) and webhooks for asynchronous event delivery, which provide a basis for background automation, but these are developer-configured API/webhook integrations rather than an AI-native automation or agent-scheduling feature. missing for 10: explicit AI-agent-driven automation builder, scheduling/cron capability, no-code automation setup, evidence of autonomous decision-making beyond fixed rule triggers.
